title: Zed DeltaDB
summary: Zed DeltaDB is a high-performance database technology developed by the Zed code editor team, designed to handle real-time collaborative editing and local-first data synchronization. It likely employs delta-based or CRDT-style algorithms for efficient change tracking and conflict resolution.
problem_solved: Enables efficient real-time collaboration and local-first data persistence for high-performance applications like code editors.
why_valuable: Provides a performant, conflict-free way to sync data across clients while maintaining offline capability, crucial for modern collaborative tools.
